sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Faithfully encodes the ship-to-case/table-lookup structure, required inputs, controlled values, units, selection evidence, Table 8 reference, and actual-grade-not-less-than-required-grade comparison.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Bind Table 8 selection to each steelGradeRequirementCase: require that case to satisfy the tableLookupCase constraints (or its linked lookup case via an existing canonical path), with tableReference exactly nltl:iacsUrI2Table8 and sh:minCount 1 for lookupSelectionEvidence. The current independent, optional hasTableLookupCase branch permits every grade case to pass without the required Table 8 selection/evidence.

Model the complete dependency contract: add the supplied ship-to-tableLookupCase nltl:hasTableLookupCase relationship and validate its Table 8 reference and selection evidence. Do not apply nltl:tableReference or nltl:lookupSelectionEvidence directly to a steelGradeRequirementCase unless that node is explicitly constrained as nltl:tableLookupCase and the lookup is tied to the corresponding steel-grade case; those properties have requiredOwner tableLookupCase. Preserve the actual-grade >= required-grade rank comparison and the case-level thickness/material/strength inputs.
Faithfully encodes the ship-to-case/table-lookup structure, required inputs, controlled values, units, selection evidence, Table 8 reference, and actual-grade-not-less-than-required-grade comparison.
